pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ Y ngược (chân chữ A), cao 175,3 m

pylon_custom.description: Inverted Y: two straight legs splay outward from a common footing up to the deck (A-frame, legs widest at the deck and wider still at the footing), pass outside the deck, converge to a single head about 70 m above deck; the head carries all stays. One cross-beam under the deck. No diamond: the legs keep splaying down to the pile cap.

model3d.notes: Shape read from Commons photos (pylon close-up from the deck; tower under construction 2007, which shows the A-frame legs and the under-deck strut). Height 175.3 m total (mageba), of which ≈135 m above deck. Side-span auxiliary piers at 40 m spacing (2×40 m end spans). Stays fan from the single head to both deck edges. Steel box girder in the main span, concrete in the side spans.

review: Pylon was a generic inverted-Y with no lower legs or strut
